negative_evidence: Several hyperparameters are chosen for qualitative comparison rather than uniquely identifying a biological mechanism.
Delayed recall is modeled with separate compression levels/models; this is not a demonstrated within-trace biological storage/consolidation update.
Information already lost at stronger compression cannot necessarily be recovered by converting representations.
Delay-to-beta mapping is an interpretive/calibration bridge, not a measured neural variable.
unresolved_issues: Delay-to-beta mapping is model interpretation, not a source-demonstrated biological retention dynamic.

annotation: beta-VAE/information-bottleneck ancestry is source acknowledged but W9 does not certify global independence

preserved_noninferences: delayed behavioral dependency does not by itself imply a storage operator
fitted latent variable does not automatically become stored memory
learned parameter does not automatically become an active controller
complexity or fit failure cannot imply A2
no genealogy path/citation is not independence
